# Cheltenham Open Data

> Collecting and sharing frequently updated local open data for Cheltenham and Gloucestershire — weather, fuel prices, flood warnings, market dates, food banks, news and more. All data is owned by the respective data providers; no liability is accepted for the accuracy of the data.

## Data pages

- [Latest News](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-news): Local news aggregation in a simple view.
- [Classifieds](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-classifieds): Local jobs, services, items for sale, and community notices.
- [Helplines and Contacts](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-helpful-contacts-reports): Help and support contact numbers and links.
- [Cheapest Fuel Prices](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-fuel-prices): Local and cheapest fuel pricing data from 112 forecourts.
- [House Prices](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-house-prices): Local house prices data from Land Registry and ONS.
- [Planning Applications](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-planning-applications): Local planning applications from Cheltenham Borough Council.
- [GP and Pharmacies](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-gp-pharmacies): Find GP practices and pharmacies in Cheltenham.
- [Post Office Locations](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-post-office-locations): Find Post Offices in Cheltenham.
- [Fix My Street](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-fix-my-street): Local street issues and reports.
- [Flood Warnings](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-flood-warnings): Local flood warnings and alerts.
- [Air Quality](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-air-quality): Local area air quality readings for Cheltenham.
- [Food Bank](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-foodbank-needed-items): Local foodbanks and their needed items.
- [Public Holidays](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-public-holidays): Confirmed public holidays.
- [Security Alerts](https://cheltenham-od.uk/cheltenham-security-alerts): National threat level from MI5, relevant given proximity to GCHQ, and Government Alerts.

## Feeds & data sources

- [Sitemap](https://cheltenham-od.uk/sitemap.xml): Full list of site URLs.
- [Announcements Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/main.xml): Site announcements feed (Atom).
- [Flood Warnings Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/flood.xml): Flood warnings feed (Atom).
- [Daily News Summary Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/news-summary.xml): Daily news updates feed (Atom).
- [Cheltenham Classifieds Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/classifieds.xml): Classifieds feed (Atom).

## Other

- [Weather](https://cheltenham-od.uk/): Daily weather summary (temperature, wind, visibility, pressure, humidity, sunrise/sunset).
- [Farmers Market dates](https://cheltenham-od.uk/): 2nd and last Friday monthly (Jan–Nov); 2nd and 3rd Friday in December.
- [News](https://cheltenham-od.uk/news): Site news.
- [About](https://cheltenham-od.uk/about): About Cheltenham Open Data.
- [Contact](https://cheltenham-od.uk/contact): Contact the site.
- [Submit Classified Advert](https://cheltenham-od.uk/submission): Submit a classified advert.
- [Privacy](https://cheltenham-od.uk/.well-known/privacy.txt): Privacy information.
- [Security](https://cheltenham-od.uk/.well-known/security.txt): Security disclosure information.
- [Site by thechels.uk](https://thechels.uk): Site author.
